title: Crash
body: App is very slow to load and crashes often. It has excellent content when it does works.

title: One week trial?
body: For an app that cost $149/year, that’s a very short trial period. Sorry to say it discourages me from trying the app, with a busy life I need more than a week to see if it works for me. Good concept though, wish you luck.

I love everything about this app and the wonderful vibe you guys bring with it! I’m an Irish citizen/ native New Yorker who registered my foreign birth a number of years ago…my grandma was from Galway. The last time we visited we stayed in Mullinivat and something changed in me! There was a beautiful herd of cows not far from the window of our room at the inn. As I had never been so close to cows I filmed and watched them every day and noticed the friendships that the cows seem to have. As a city dweller, I had never seen this. I changed to a plant based diet after our stay. As a new vegan the recipes have been SO helpful and very much enjoyed. Thank you for the wonderful recipes, the videos, community and the good vibes! Will definitely be stopping by The Happy Pear when we visit next ☮️☘️🥰

title: Amazing app!!
body: If only I had a dollar for every app I download and never use. But Happy Pear is different - I just love it - everything you need is at your fingertips- food, fitness, yoga , encouragement- it’s all there!!

title: The Happy Pear for a Happy New Year
body: I am so glad I found The Happy Pear! The app is filled with amazing resources that have helped me embrace a healthier lifestyle, specifically, how to love eating more veggies. Dave and Steve, Irish twins who are the happy pair, are full of joy and happiness as they demo just how easy it is to make delicious whole food plant based foods. They have been at it over 20 years running a cafe, writing cookbooks, being role models for healthy living. Included in the app are many courses to learn new cooking skills, such as, sourdough bread baking, vegan baking, quick and easy meals, plant based cooking, fermenting… There are also courses included free in the app for happy sleep, happy gut, happy shape, happy heart, happy skin, happy menopause, etc. There are other resources like stretching, yoga, breathing classes, podcasts and so much more. I just watched their Christmas cook-along and am joyfully equipped to go and cook our Christmas dinner! The app also offers an invitation into the Happy Pear community with Dave, Steve and members sharing positive, healthy things they are making and doing to support a happy healthy lifestyle. This is an app that you will enjoy using a lot! If you are thinking about being healthier in the new year, this app will help you get there. Hope you’ll join us 🙂🍐🙂🍐

title: Helpful cooking instruction videos
body: The cooking tips are helpful for beginners. Great personalities. Great info. (Wish it were easier to pick up in the middle of videos after a break)

title: Amazing App with a Fab Community!
body: I cannot stress how much we adore this app! The courses are phenomenal, the recipes are delish, and the lads and their team have made such a beautiful and welcoming community. The support and encouragement you receive are amazing! There’s also meditations, exercises, and breath work, along with their wonderful podcast. This is truly the only app you’ll ever need!

title: All Around Great Healthy Lifestyle App
body: I love how this app includes healthy recipes, podcasts, workout classes, a community and more all in one place! I love how it is organized across the bottom with various categories and have found it great to search for recipes by an ingredient or category. Overall has been wonderful app in making it easy to live a healthier & happier lifestyle!

title: Great App to help with health
body: I enjoy using The Happy Pear app! Lots of great healthy recipes and a kind “tribe” to chat with. You can tell Steve and Dave care about health and more importantly people!

title: Great energy awesome community
body: So happy I discovered this community who really cares about quality food and healthy lifestyle. Well worth the price.
